panels.title: At a glance
panels.description: Current health plus usage in the selected time range. Blank traffic ratios mean no calls were observed.

panels.title: Gateway status
panels.description: Running means Prometheus has a healthy gateway sample; Down means the exporter reports the gateway offline. No data means Prometheus returned no sample; check exporter and scrape availability before concluding the gateway is down.

panels.title: Failed API requests
panels.description: Failed model API calls divided by all model API calls in the current rate interval. No data means no recorded calls in that interval.

panels.title: Average model response time
panels.description: Mean duration of recorded model API calls, including failures, in the current rate interval. No data means no recorded calls.

panels.title: Time since last backup
panels.description: Hours since the latest backup. Compare with the backup schedule if this grows.

panels.title: Disk space used
panels.description: Share of the monitored filesystem already used. Check host storage before it reaches capacity.

panels.title: Estimated LLM cost (selected range)
panels.description: Estimated recorded model cost over the selected Grafana time range, in USD. Missing prices can understate this value; it is not an invoice.

panels.title: Tokens used (selected range)
panels.description: Total recorded input and output tokens over the selected Grafana time range.

panels.title: Usage and tools
panels.description: Traffic rates show activity over time; selected-range totals are cumulative for the time picker.

panels.title: Tokens per second by model
panels.description: Recorded input and output tokens per second, split by provider and model. Use this to see which routes drive traffic.

panels.title: Tool calls per second by status
panels.description: Tool calls per second by tool and outcome. Error series reveal failing tools.
Input and output tokens per second by provider and model; input and output are separate series.
panels.title: Input and output tokens per second
User profiles
panels.description: Request counts come from saved Hermes history and exclude unrecorded work.
User messages recorded in Hermes history during each preceding hour, by profile. This is a rolling count, not LLM calls.
panels.title: Requests by profile (last hour)

panels.description: Recorded user messages over rolling 24-hour and 7-day windows and stored history. History deletion or restore can change stored counts.
panels.title: Requests by profile (24h / 7d / stored)

panels.description: Approximate cumulative time between user messages and assistant responses over rolling 1-hour, 24-hour and 7-day windows. Not CPU time.
panels.title: Time spent answering (rolling windows)

panels.description: Duration of each profile’s latest completed request. The value persists until another request completes.
panels.title: Last completed request duration

panels.description: Most recent recorded user or assistant event by profile. No activity means an empty readable history; No data can mean history collection failed.
panels.title: Profile last activity
Model reliability and routing
panels.description: Compare availability, latency, rate limits, retries and routing changes before choosing a model.
Successful model API calls divided by all calls for each provider and model during the current rate interval.

targets.expr: sum by (provider, model) (rate(hermes_api_success_total[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (provider, model) (rate(hermes_api_success_total[$__rate_interval]) + rate(hermes_api_errors_total[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Successful API responses by model

panels.description: Mean model API response time by provider and model in the current rate interval, in milliseconds.

targets.expr: sum by (provider, model) (rate(hermes_api_duration_ms_total[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (provider, model) (rate(hermes_api_calls_total[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Average model response time by route

panels.description: Rate-limited model API calls per second by provider and model. The rate interval adapts to the selected time range.
panels.title: Rate-limited requests per second

panels.description: Recorded provider retry attempts per second by provider and model. Spikes indicate unstable routes.
panels.title: Retries per second by model

panels.description: Number of failed model API calls in each error class over time. Use the route scorecard and latest events to identify affected models.

targets.queryText: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 60)) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 60) AS time, CASE WHEN (status_code = 429 OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%rate%limit%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%too many requests%') THEN 'rate_limit' WHEN status_code IN (408, 504) OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%timeout%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%timed out%' THEN 'timeout' WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN 'server' WHEN status_code IN (401, 403) THEN 'auth' WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 'client' WHEN lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%connect%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%network%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%dns%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%reset%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%ssl%' THEN 'network' ELSE 'other' END AS route, COUNT(*) AS errors FROM api_calls WHERE status != 'ok' AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 60)) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 60) AS time, CASE WHEN (status_code = 429 OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%rate%limit%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%too many requests%') THEN 'rate_limit' WHEN status_code IN (408, 504) OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%timeout%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%timed out%' THEN 'timeout' WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN 'server' WHEN status_code IN (401, 403) THEN 'auth' WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 'client' WHEN lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%connect%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%network%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%dns%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%reset%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%ssl%' THEN 'network' ELSE 'other' END AS route, COUNT(*) AS errors FROM api_calls WHERE status != 'ok' AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: API errors by class

panels.description: 95th percentile response time of successful model calls in each time bucket. Slow tails can be hidden by averages.

targets.queryText: WITH ok AS ( SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 60)) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 60) AS time, provider || ' / ' || model AS route, duration_ms FROM api_calls WHERE status = 'ok' AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')), ranked AS ( SELECT time, route, duration_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY time, route ORDER BY duration_ms) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY time, route) AS cnt FROM ok) SELECT time, route, MIN(CASE WHEN rn >= 0.95 * cnt THEN duration_ms END) AS p95_ms FROM ranked GROUP BY time, route ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: WITH ok AS ( SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 60)) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 60) AS time, provider || ' / ' || model AS route, duration_ms FROM api_calls WHERE status = 'ok' AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')), ranked AS ( SELECT time, route, duration_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY time, route ORDER BY duration_ms) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY time, route) AS cnt FROM ok) SELECT time, route, MIN(CASE WHEN rn >= 0.95 * cnt THEN duration_ms END) AS p95_ms FROM ranked GROUP BY time, route ORDER BY time

panels.title: Slow model responses (p95)

panels.description: Successful model calls grouped by provider finish reason. Length means the response was truncated; unknown means no reason was reported.

targets.queryText: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 60)) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 60) AS time, CASE lower(COALESCE(finish_reason, '')) WHEN 'stop' THEN 'stop' WHEN 'end_turn' THEN 'stop' WHEN 'stop_sequence' THEN 'stop' WHEN 'length' THEN 'length' WHEN 'max_tokens' THEN 'length' WHEN 'tool_calls' THEN 'tool_calls' WHEN 'tool_use' THEN 'tool_calls' WHEN 'function_call' THEN 'tool_calls' WHEN 'content_filter' THEN 'content_filter' WHEN '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'other' END AS route, COUNT(*) AS responses FROM api_calls WHERE status = 'ok' AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 60)) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 60) AS time, CASE lower(COALESCE(finish_reason, '')) WHEN 'stop' THEN 'stop' WHEN 'end_turn' THEN 'stop' WHEN 'stop_sequence' THEN 'stop' WHEN 'length' THEN 'length' WHEN 'max_tokens' THEN 'length' WHEN 'tool_calls' THEN 'tool_calls' WHEN 'tool_use' THEN 'tool_calls' WHEN 'function_call' THEN 'tool_calls' WHEN 'content_filter' THEN 'content_filter' WHEN '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'other' END AS route, COUNT(*) AS responses FROM api_calls WHERE status = 'ok' AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Finish reasons

panels.description: Model or provider switches recorded during the selected time range. Frequent switches can signal an unstable route.

targets.queryText: SELECT from_provider || ' / ' || from_model AS "From", to_provider || ' / ' || to_model AS "To", COUNT(*) AS "Switches", MAX(ts) AS "Last switch" FROM route_fallbacks WHERE ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT from_provider || ' / ' || from_model AS "From", to_provider || ' / ' || to_model AS "To", COUNT(*) AS "Switches", MAX(ts) AS "Last switch" FROM route_fallbacks WHERE ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Route fallbacks — selected range

panels.description: Compare model routes in the selected range: availability, first-attempt success, p95 time, output speed, truncated or empty replies and cost per success. These are operational proxies, not answer quality scores.

targets.queryText: WITH calls AS ( SELECT a.provider, a.model, a.status, a.duration_ms, a.input_tokens, a.output_tokens, a.total_tokens, a.cost_usd, a.finish_reason, a.status_code, a.retry_count, CASE WHEN a.status = 'ok' AND (COALESCE(a.call_index, 0) = 0 OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM api_calls e WHERE e.status != 'ok' AND e.session_id = a.session_id AND e.call_index = a.call_index AND e.ts <= a.ts)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS first_attempt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.provider, a.model, a.status ORDER BY a.duration_ms) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.provider, a.model, a.status) AS cnt FROM api_calls a WHERE ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')) SELECT provider AS "Provider", model AS "Model", 1.0 * SUM(status = 'ok') / COUNT(*) AS "Availability", 1.0 * SUM(first_attempt) / NULLIF(SUM(status = 'ok'), 0) AS "First-attempt success", MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' AND rn >= 0.95 * cnt THEN duration_ms END) AS "p95 response time", 1000.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN output_tokens END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN duration_ms END), 0) AS "Output tok/s", 1.0 * SUM(status = 'ok' AND lower(COALESCE(finish_reason, '')) IN ('length', 'max_tokens')) / NULLIF(SUM(status = 'ok'), 0) AS "Truncated", 1.0 * SUM(status = 'ok' AND COALESCE(output_tokens, 0) = 0 AND (COALESCE(input_tokens, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(total_tokens, 0) > 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(status = 'ok'), 0) AS "Empty responses", SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN cost_usd END) / NULLIF(SUM(status = 'ok'), 0) AS "Cost per success", SUM(status = 'ok') AS "Successes", SUM(status != 'ok') AS "Errors", SUM((status_code = 429 OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%rate%limit%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%too many requests%')) AS "Rate limits", SUM(COALESCE(retry_count, 0)) AS "Retries" FROM calls GROUP BY provider, model ORDER BY 3 DESC
targets.rawQueryText: WITH calls AS ( SELECT a.provider, a.model, a.status, a.duration_ms, a.input_tokens, a.output_tokens, a.total_tokens, a.cost_usd, a.finish_reason, a.status_code, a.retry_count, CASE WHEN a.status = 'ok' AND (COALESCE(a.call_index, 0) = 0 OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM api_calls e WHERE e.status != 'ok' AND e.session_id = a.session_id AND e.call_index = a.call_index AND e.ts <= a.ts)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS first_attempt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.provider, a.model, a.status ORDER BY a.duration_ms) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.provider, a.model, a.status) AS cnt FROM api_calls a WHERE ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')) SELECT provider AS "Provider", model AS "Model", 1.0 * SUM(status = 'ok') / COUNT(*) AS "Availability", 1.0 * SUM(first_attempt) / NULLIF(SUM(status = 'ok'), 0) AS "First-attempt success", MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' AND rn >= 0.95 * cnt THEN duration_ms END) AS "p95 response time", 1000.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN output_tokens END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN duration_ms END), 0) AS "Output tok/s", 1.0 * SUM(status = 'ok' AND lower(COALESCE(finish_reason, '')) IN ('length', 'max_tokens')) / NULLIF(SUM(status = 'ok'), 0) AS "Truncated", 1.0 * SUM(status = 'ok' AND COALESCE(output_tokens, 0) = 0 AND (COALESCE(input_tokens, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(total_tokens, 0) > 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(status = 'ok'), 0) AS "Empty responses", SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN cost_usd END) / NULLIF(SUM(status = 'ok'), 0) AS "Cost per success", SUM(status = 'ok') AS "Successes", SUM(status != 'ok') AS "Errors", SUM((status_code = 429 OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%rate%limit%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%too many requests%')) AS "Rate limits", SUM(COALESCE(retry_count, 0)) AS "Retries" FROM calls GROUP BY provider, model ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Route scorecard — selected range

panels.description: Most recent success, error and rate-limit timestamps per provider and model in retained history, independent of the time picker.

targets.queryText: SELECT provider AS "Provider", model AS "Model", MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN ts END) AS "Last success", MAX(CASE WHEN status != 'ok' THEN ts END) AS "Last error", MAX(CASE WHEN (status_code = 429 OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%rate%limit%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%too many requests%') THEN ts END) AS "Last rate limit" FROM api_calls GROUP BY provider, model ORDER BY 3 DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT provider AS "Provider", model AS "Model", MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN ts END) AS "Last success", MAX(CASE WHEN status != 'ok' THEN ts END) AS "Last error", MAX(CASE WHEN (status_code = 429 OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%rate%limit%' OR lower(finish_reason) LIKE '%too many requests%') THEN ts END) AS "Last rate limit" FROM api_calls GROUP BY provider, model ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Model/provider — latest availability events

panels.description: Share and count of failed tool calls by the model active in the session during the selected range.

targets.queryText: WITH calls AS ( SELECT t.status, COALESCE((SELECT s.model FROM sessions s WHERE s.session_id = t.session_id AND s.event = 'start' AND s.ts <= t.ts ORDER BY s.ts DESC LIMIT 1), 'unknown') AS model FROM tool_calls t WHERE ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')) SELECT model AS "Model", 1.0 * SUM(status != 'ok') / COUNT(*) AS "Failed share", COUNT(*) AS "Tool calls" FROM calls GROUP BY model ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1
targets.rawQueryText: WITH calls AS ( SELECT t.status, COALESCE((SELECT s.model FROM sessions s WHERE s.session_id = t.session_id AND s.event = 'start' AND s.ts <= t.ts ORDER BY s.ts DESC LIMIT 1), 'unknown') AS model FROM tool_calls t WHERE ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch')) SELECT model AS "Model", 1.0 * SUM(status != 'ok') / COUNT(*) AS "Failed share", COUNT(*) AS "Tool calls" FROM calls GROUP BY model ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

panels.title: Tool call failures by model — selected range

panels.description: Calls served by a different model than requested during the selected range. Check these before comparing route performance.

targets.queryText: SELECT provider AS "Provider", requested_model AS "Requested", model AS "Served", COUNT(*) AS "Responses", MAX(ts) AS "Last seen" FROM api_calls WHERE COALESCE(requested_model, '') != '' AND requested_model != model AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT provider AS "Provider", requested_model AS "Requested", model AS "Served", COUNT(*) AS "Responses", MAX(ts) AS "Last seen" FROM api_calls WHERE COALESCE(requested_model, '') != '' AND requested_model != model AND ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Requested vs served model — selected range
VPS resources
panels.description: Capacity and process use; host load, CPU cores and percentages use separate axes.

panels.title: Memory and disk free
panels.description: Share of RAM and disk capacity available to the host. Lower values mean less headroom.

panels.title: Gateway RAM and host RAM available
panels.description: Gateway resident memory and host memory still available, both in bytes. A shrinking available host memory line may indicate pressure.

panels.title: Gateway CPU use (cores)
panels.description: CPU cores occupied by the Hermes gateway process. A value of 1 means one fully used core.

panels.title: Host CPU used
panels.description: Share of total host CPU capacity used across all cores.

panels.title: Host load
panels.description: Host load averages over 1, 5 and 15 minutes. Load is runnable work, not a percent; compare it with CPU capacity.

panels.title: Inodes used
panels.description: Share of filesystem inodes already used. High usage can prevent new files even when disk space remains.

panels.title: AI review in CI
panels.description: Imported published review outcomes and provider processing times.
Published CI review runs in the selected range, with outcome, validated chunks, attempts, retries and provider time.

targets.queryText: SELECT observed_at AS "Observed", reviewer AS "Reviewer", provider AS "Provider", model AS "Model", outcome AS "Outcome", validated_chunks || '/' || NULLIF(total_chunks, 0) AS "Chunks", attempts AS "Attempts", retries AS "Retries", provider_seconds AS "Provider seconds", head_sha AS "Head SHA" FROM review_runs WHERE observed_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND observed_at < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') ORDER BY observed_at DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT observed_at AS "Observed", reviewer AS "Reviewer", provider AS "Provider", model AS "Model", outcome AS "Outcome", validated_chunks || '/' || NULLIF(total_chunks, 0) AS "Chunks", attempts AS "Attempts", retries AS "Retries", provider_seconds AS "Provider seconds", head_sha AS "Head SHA" FROM review_runs WHERE observed_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND observed_at < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') ORDER BY observed_at DESC

panels.title: AI review runs — selected range

panels.description: Time spent by the provider on each imported CI review run. Each point represents one review.

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', observed_at) AS INTEGER) AS time, provider || ' / ' || model || ' · ' || reviewer AS route, provider_seconds AS seconds FROM review_runs WHERE observed_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND observed_at < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', observed_at) AS INTEGER) AS time, provider || ' / ' || model || ' · ' || reviewer AS route, provider_seconds AS seconds FROM review_runs WHERE observed_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__from / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') AND observed_at < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%f', $__to / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') ORDER BY time
